mapper.insert: insert into ssm_portal ( portal_id, portal_name, portal_desc, sort_id, is_active, created_by, created_time ) values ( #{portalId}, #{portalName}, #{portalDesc}, #{sortId}, 1, #{createdBy}, now() )
mapper.update: update ssm_portal set portal_name = #{portalName}, portal_desc = #{portalDesc}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_time = now() where portal_id = #{portalId}
mapper.select: SELECT portal_id as portalId, portal_name as portalName, portal_desc as portalDesc FROM ssm_portal WHERE is_active = 1 ORDER BY sort_id
select portal_id as portalId, portal_name as portalName, portal_desc as portalDesc, sort_id as sortId, is_active as isActive from ssm_portal where portal_id = #{portalId}
select portal_id as portalId from ssm_portal_menu where content_ref_id = #{contentRefId} limit 1

SELECT t1.portal_id FROM ssm_portal_menu t1 INNER JOIN ssm_analysis_tpl_base t2 ON t1.content_ref_id = t2.analysis_tpl_id WHERE t1.is_active = 1 AND t2.is_active = 1 AND t2.online_status = 'online' GROUP BY t1.portal_id
